VariableTypeID.description:
Variable the alert watches. User-defined variables are 1000 or
higher. Predefined: 1 temperature, 2 humidity, 3 light level,
4 setpoint, 5 volume, 6 active energy, 7 run time, 8 discrete
sensor state, 9 dimmerization, 10 weight, 11 flow, 12 voltage,
13 current, 14 active power, 15 reactive power, 16 apparent power,
17 power factor, 18 pressure, 19 frequency, 20 ppm concentration,
21 mass/volume concentration, 22 AQI, 23 people flow, 24 people
count, 25 reactive energy, 26 apparent energy, 27 location.

Threshold.description: Value compared with `ConditionType` to trigger the alert.

NormalThreshold.description: Value compared with `NormalConditionType` to close the alert.

MinimumDurationSeconds.description: Seconds the condition must hold before the alert triggers.

Enabled.description: False when the alert was deleted. Deleted alerts only appear in the incremental list.

ConditionType.description: 1 equal, 2 not equal, 3 greater, 4 greater or equal, 5 lower, 6 lower or equal.
